name: reading_list_items_is_not_repeated_after_the_apis_own_timeout
description: Reading a saved list's items charges each record shown whole whose 90-day unlock has lapsed, before it unlocks them again. The API's own 504 upstream.timeout says the time budget ran out, which may be after the charge, so the read is raised with a note that it may have been charged rather than repeated.

body.title: Upstream timed out
body.next_step: Retry, or narrow the request so it finishes sooner.
